title: Which endpoint can another site trigger?
brief: Three account routes. Two of them check that the request really came from Aurora's own page. Point at the handler that doesn't.

decoyLines.1: a GET that only reads is not the target of a forged request — nothing changes
decoyLines.5: this one has verifyCsrf in its chain; the forged request will not carry a valid token
decoyLines.10: the body of the handler is fine; the missing check is on the line that declares it

functionalSuite.value: A customer changing their own password
functionalSuite.label: Still needs to work

hints: Look at the middleware list on each route. What is present on one POST and absent on the other?
A GET that only reads is not the danger. Find the state-changing route with the shortest middleware chain.
